items.summary: SigMap introduces a technique that achieves a 97% token reduction for AI coding sessions, optimizing the management of AI context.

items.title: Fidx – local semantic search in one SQLite file, no LLM at query
items.summary: Fidx is a system for local semantic search, storing information in a SQLite file without requiring an LLM for querying, focusing on data retrieval methods.
